messages:
kevin: Hey folks, first day hiccup. Ran the dotfiles bootstrap but my asdf shims aren't being picked up and global npm packages keep ending up in /usr/local. MacBook Pro (corporate) — says Apple M1 in About but I see /usr/local binaries. Any quick checks?

sangeeta: welcome! :wave: Quick checks: `which asdf`, `echo $PATH`, and `cat ~/.tool-versions` if present. Also `npm config get prefix` to see where npm globals go.

kevin: `which asdf` -> /opt/homebrew/bin/asdf, `echo $PATH` shows /usr/bin before /Users/kevin/.asdf/shims, `npm config get prefix` -> /usr/local (ugh). ~./tool-versions is empty. Dotfiles added `export PATH="$HOME/.asdf/bin:$PATH"` to my zprofile.

maria: ordering matters. Make sure asdf's shims are early and you source asdf: put near top of your rc: `. $(brew --prefix asdf)/libexec/asdf.sh` and `export PATH="$HOME/.asdf/bin:$HOME/.asdf/shims:$PATH"`. If zprofile vs zshrc is confusing, source zshrc from zprofile so interactive shells see the same env.

sangeeta: for npm: run `mkdir -p ~/.local/npm && npm config set prefix "$HOME/.local/npm"` then add `export PATH="$HOME/.local/npm/bin:$PATH"` into your rc before other PATH tweaks. That keeps you from needing sudo.

kevin: added the asdf source lines and moved PATH exports to top, restarted shell. `asdf plugin-list` shows python,nodejs. `asdf install python 3.10.12` failed with openssl header errors.

maria: macOS dev libs fix: `brew install openssl readline xz zlib` then export flags before build: `export LDFLAGS="-L$(brew --prefix openssl)/lib"` and `export CPPFLAGS="-I$(brew --prefix openssl)/include"` then retry `asdf install`. Use `$(brew --prefix)` so it works whether brew is in /opt/homebrew or /usr/local.

kevin: installed the brew deps and retried, python built fine. Reinstalled pnpm after setting npm prefix to ~/.local/npm — `which pnpm` -> /Users/kevin/.local/npm/bin/pnpm. One last weirdness: I had Volta leftovers that put node earlier on PATH. `which node` referenced ~/.volta. Should I remove Volta?

sangeeta: yes if we standardize on asdf we remove conflicting managers. `volta uninstall` or remove its PATH bits. After that run `asdf reshim` or `asdf where python` to verify shims point to the asdf-installed runtimes.

kevin: removed Volta, ran `asdf reshim`, `asdf current` shows python 3.10.12 and node 18.17.0 after `direnv allow`. All green now, thanks! :raised_hands:

it-support-bot: Ticket INF-1344 created: "dotfiles onboarding: document npm home prefix (~/.local/npm), asdf.sh ordering, and Volta conflict" assigned to @maria.

kevin: I'll open a tiny README PR adding the npm prefix example and a note about zprofile vs zshrc. Appreciate the quick help!
